title: The Stepping onto the Small Stage Edge
youtube_title: The Stepping onto the Small Stage Edge | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Trying the smallest brave step still counts.
summary: At a bakery counter facing the street, Remy feels shy about an edge of a very small stage. Instead of pretending not to care, Remy tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while the ferryman stays kind and does not push for a show.
